title: Pressed
challenge: A small press working with farming families, with a genuinely better process. Its label hid that process behind farmland clichés and gold foil, the same story every competitor told.
insight: Shoppers had stopped believing words like “pure” and “natural”. What they trusted was evidence they could check for themselves.
idea: We let the facts do the talking. One typographic label lists what’s in the bottle, the pressing date and the farm it came from, set with the precision of a lab sample. Nothing decorative: the information is the design.
outcome: A label people actually read, and trust earned by telling the truth.
